CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	seq BIGINT DEFAULT nextval('audit_sequence') NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	trace_id VARCHAR(256), 
	event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	prev_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256), 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (customer_id, prev_hash)
)


CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	jti VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (jti)
)


CREATE TABLE cooldowns (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	payee_fingerprint VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	until_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, payee_fingerprint)
)


CREATE TABLE event_decisions (
	event_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(64), 
	decided_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('SUCCESS','BLOCKED','FAILED_INSUFFICIENT','SKIPPED_REAPPROVAL'))
)


CREATE TABLE ip_ratelimit (
	ip VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_started_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (ip)
)


CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	read_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (event_id, type)
)


CREATE TABLE pin_failures (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	failed_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	locked_until_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_failed_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
)


CREATE TABLE request_dedup (
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	route VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	response JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, route, request_id)
)


CREATE TABLE scheduled_grants (
	instruction_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	scope_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	scope_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approved_risk VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (instruction_id), 
	CHECK (approved_risk IN ('GREEN','YELLOW','RED') AND status IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED'))
)


CREATE TABLE sessions (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_epoch BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE workflow_events (
	event_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256), 
	step_id VARCHAR(256), 
	action_kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(256), 
	amount_cents BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','COMMITTED','BLOCKED'))
)


CREATE TABLE form_actions (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action_kind VARCHAR(64), 
	normalized_fields JSONB NOT NULL, 
	parent_utterance_id VARCHAR(256), 
	parent_plan_id VARCHAR(256), 
	view_hash VARCHAR, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	used_by VARCHAR(256), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (kind IN ('FORM','CLARIFICATION')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE hints (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	scope_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	parent_plan_id VARCHAR(256), 
	view_hash VARCHAR, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	used_by VARCHAR(256), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE pending_clarifications (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_template_id VARCHAR(256), 
	parent_utterance_ids JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	authorization_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	required_fields JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	candidate_refs JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	partial_scope JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (kind IN ('SLOTS','FORM_REQUIRED')), 
	CHECK (status IN ('OPEN','RESOLVED','CANCELLED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE plans (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	steps_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resolved_steps JSONB NOT NULL, 
	utterance_ids JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	scope_ids JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('EVALUATED','REPLAN','DENIED','PENDING_APPROVAL','CONFIRMED','EXECUTING','UNKNOWN','EXECUTED','FAILED','REJECTED','EXPIRED','SUPERSEDED') AND origin IN ('agent','app_form')), 
	UNIQUE (customer_id, origin, request_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE read_records (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	tool VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	canonical_args JSONB NOT NULL, 
	response JSONB NOT NULL, 
	untrusted_paths JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	versions JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	raw_text VARCHAR(8192), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE utterances (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT, 
	normalized_scope JSONB NOT NULL, 
	echoes_untrusted BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256), 
	parent_ids JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parse_status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'SCOPED' NOT NULL, 
	clarification_id VARCHAR(256), 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	consumed_by VARCHAR(256), 
	authorization_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (kind IN ('typed','hint','action','context')), 
	CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','CONSUMED','CANCELLED')), 
	CHECK (parse_status IN ('SCOPED','NO_WRITE','INTENT_UNCLEAR','CLARIFYING')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE authorization_claims (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('CLAIMED','CONSUMED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES plans (id)
)


CREATE TABLE evaluations (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	decision JSONB NOT NULL, 
	risk VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	findings JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	preflight JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	versions JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	view_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	equivalent_to VARCHAR(256), 
	clock_version BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (risk IN ('GREEN','YELLOW','RED') AND revision >= 1), 
	UNIQUE (plan_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES plans (id)
)


CREATE TABLE execution_jobs (
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	l3_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	last_error JSONB, 
	result JSONB, 
	created_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	deadline_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (plan_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES plans (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('EXECUTING','UNKNOWN','EXECUTED','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
)


CREATE TABLE approvals (
	id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	evaluation_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	customer_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	sid VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	view_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	binding_mac VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	risk_ack BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','REJECTED','EXPIRED','SUPERSEDED','USED','LOCKED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evaluation_id) REFERENCES evaluations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sid) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE otp_challenges (
	approval_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	code_digest VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	view_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	sent_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	last_sent_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	locked_at_wall TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (approval_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES approvals (id)
)

CREATE INDEX approvals_customer_status ON approvals (customer_id, status)
CREATE INDEX audit_customer_seq ON audit_events (customer_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX audit_plan ON audit_events (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX auth_sessions_customer ON auth_sessions (customer_id, revoked_at_wall)
CREATE INDEX evaluations_plan_time ON evaluations (plan_id, created_at_wall)
CREATE INDEX notifications_customer_read ON notifications (customer_id, read_at_wall)
CREATE INDEX plans_sid ON plans (sid)
CREATE INDEX read_records_sid ON read_records (sid)
CREATE INDEX utterances_sid_status ON utterances (sid, status)
CREATE INDEX workflow_customer_time ON workflow_events (customer_id, occurred_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_clarification_per_session ON pending_clarifications (sid) WHERE status = 'OPEN'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_pending_approval_per_session ON approvals (sid) WHERE status = 'PENDING'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_usable_approval_per_plan ON approvals (plan_id) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
